title_sq: Super apartament 2+1+2 dhe garazh i perfshire ne rrugen e Durresit prane Colosseo (ID 41212201)
description_sq:
Ne rrugen e Durresit, prane Hotel Colosseo, ofrohet per shitje super apartament 2+1+2, siperfaqe totale 117.5 m², kati i 3 ne ndertim te ri me ashensor, i mobiluar totalisht me arkitekt, punuar ne detajme punime cilesore.
Apartamenti organizohet ne: sallon ndenje dhe ambient gatimi, 2 dhoma gumi, 2 tualete, 2 ballkone, korridor shperndares.
Vlera e mobilimit eshte 68 000 euro.
Shitet se bashku me garazhin me siperfaqe 28 m² ne katin -1.
Shitet i mobiluar.
Ne proces hipotekimi.
Shitet 370 000 euro.
title_en: Super apartment 2+1+2 and included garage on Durres street near Colosseo (ID 41212201)
description_en: On Durres street, near the Hotel Colosseo, a super apartment 2+1+2, total area 117.5 m², 3rd floor in a new building with elevator, fully furnished by an architect, quality workmanship is offered for sale. The apartment is organized in: living room and kitchen area, 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, 2 balconies, distribution corridor. The value of the furniture is 68,000 euros. It is sold together with the garage with an area of ​​28 m² on the -1st floor. For sale furnished. In the mortgage process. For sale, 370,000 euros.
